question: Does the applicant need an immigration medical examination?

claims.text: The submitted medical examination was conducted by an unregistered physician at an unauthorized facility, failing the requirement that applicants undergo an examination by a designated panel physician and hold a valid medical certificate.
claims.quote: Every foreign national who must submit to an IME **must hold a valid medical certificate before a final decision can be made on their application**.

basis: The applicant uploaded a document under slot type medical_examination for opaque case ID 235ea061f338b12a1dc82469a39c3a18.
The document narrative states that the examination was performed by Dr. Alan Miller (UNREGISTERED-999) at Sunrise Family General Practice, who is an unregistered physician at an unauthorized clinic.
